root_cause: The disclosure menu does not close when focus leaves the menu via keyboard navigation (e.g., Tabbing out). The focusState is only set on focus-in but never reset on focus-out, so the dropdown remains open.
repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener to the menu element that detects when the related target is outside the menu and closes the controlling toggle (either the menu's own controller for top-level menus or the parent menu's controller for submenus).
expected_accessibility_effect: When focus leaves the menu via keyboard (Tab), the dropdown closes, ensuring aria-expanded becomes false and the submenu is hidden.
functional_risks: May close menus prematurely if focus moves to a widget outside the menu that is programmatically triggered (e.g., a dialog opened from a menu item).
For submenus, closing when focus leaves to parent button is expected, but could interfere with custom widgets that expect the submenu to stay open while interacting with an external trigger.
verification_requirements: Tabbing from the Shop button to the search input should result in aria-expanded=\"false\" on #shop and #plants not visible.
Escape key should still close the Shop dropdown and return focus to the Shop button.
Opening the Shop dropdown with Enter and then pressing Tab to navigate within the dropdown should keep it open until focus leaves the menu.
